content.title: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI before 2027? — Discussion
content.text: This market will resolve to "Yes" if OpenAI or an official representative of the company announces that it has created an artificial general intelligence (AGI) by December 31, 2026 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from OpenAI and/or its official representative, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects an 81% implied probability for "No" on OpenAI announcing artificial general intelligence (AGI)—defined as highly autonomous systems outperforming humans at most economically valuable work—before 2027, driven by the absence of any official AGI claim despite accelerating progress in large language models like o1 and upcoming releases such as the "Spud" model. Recent catalysts include CEO Sam Altman's March 2026 reorganization renaming the product team to "AGI Deployment," signaling a shift toward scaling AI capabilities rather than declaring victory, alongside his February warnings of speeding timelines but no breakthroughs announced. OpenAI's October 2025 roadmap outlined AI research interns by late 2026 and full AGI-level researchers by 2028, tempering near-term expectations amid historical delays and competitive pressures from Anthropic and xAI; watch Q2 earnings and developer previews for potential shifts.This market will resolve to "Yes" if OpenAI or an official representative of the company announces that it has created an artificial general intelligence (AGI) by December 31, 2026 ET.
